answer: A field yields only what was sown in it, and the harvest is counted against the sowing. Proof of goldsmith hallmark via goldsmiths company counts the harvest: a hallmark the goldsmiths company strikes only after the smith assays a piece he actually wrought. The relic is the seed, sown by a hand that worked the ground; the bridge is the sheaf, cut by the same hand at harvest. A cheat must sow 53 false fields and reap 53 false sheaves, and the whisper keeps the count of every field that was never sown.
